EventSection.EventDescription: Infusion pump administered 12.0 mg/h of norepinephrine when the prescribed dose was 1.2 mcg/h. Device firmware 2.18.3 changed the unit-mode default from mcg/h to mg/h without user action, resulting in a 10-fold dose error. Patient experienced bilateral pulmonary edema and haemodynamic instability, resolving within 2 hours.
